boundary.description: SW at Clayton Hey Farm and by the footpath W of the Sewerage Works. W by Showley Brook to and S by Saccary Lane, Zechariah Brow  and Barker Lane. W by Arley Brook and the Ribble Valley - Blackburn with Darwen civil boundary crossing Preston New Road A677 just north of Yew Tree Drive A6119 to the Ribble Valley - Blackburn with Darwen civil boundary then to the Ribble Valley - South Ribble civil boundary to where it crosses Further Lane near Alum Scar Lane then by a  straight line north to Higher Barn Farm (presently KFC takeaway) crossing Preston New Road by a straight line NW  across Samlesbury airfield to meet the Ribble Valley - South Ribble civil boundary  at Myerscough Smithy on the A59, then by Ribble Valley - South Ribble civil boundary to the River Ribble at Spring Wood along River Ribble to Waterside Farm, and by a beeline to and along Ribchester Road to Clayton Hey Farm.
